item.title: From US unilateral halt to regime collapse: scenarios for ending Iran war
item.description: Israel says any deal must curb Iran’s nuclear and missile programs, limit support for Hezbollah and ensure strict oversight, warning weaker terms could allow Tehran to recover and risk renewed conflict

item.title: Israel warns Iran threat to Jews abroad is at record level before Passover
item.description: National Security Council assessment comes as security agencies continue to thwart plots worldwide, with dozens of attempted attacks foiled, many of them never made public

item.title: Report: Israeli attack in the Caspian Sea hit Russian-Iranian arms smuggling route
item.description: Last week’s strike near Bandar Anzali reportedly targeted key smuggling corridor used to move ammunition, drones and other weapons between Russia and Iran, disrupting military supply lines and signaling Israel can reach deep into the Caspian

item.title: קלוד תחת אש: טראמפ רוצה לזרוק, אבל הצבא חייב אותו
item.description: אחרי שהקריס את המניות של ענקיות הטק והציב איום על פרנסתם של המתכנתים, מודל ה–AI "קלוד" מחולל מהפכה גם במלחמה עם איראן ועוזר לצבא האמריקאי לשפר את הביצועים. אנת'רופיק, המפתחת שלו, מתעקשת להגדיר קווים מוסריים לשימוש בו ומוציאה את טראמפ מהכלים

item.title: IDF boosts ground forces in Lebanon, seeks broader gains against Hezbollah
item.description: The 91st and 36th divisions are operating along the border, with the 162nd and 98th set to join; forces are expanding the security zone, aiming to push Hezbollah terrorists and infrastructure north toward the Litani River

item.title: Woman killed in Hezbollah rocket attack laid to rest in Golan Heights
item.description: Nuriel Dubin, 27, had been due to marry in September; the couple met during a previous round of fighting while staying at a hotel for the displaced

item.title: 14-year-old charged with spying for Iran, received $1,170 in cryptocurrency
item.description: A teen from central Israel is accused of spraying graffiti and filming sensitive sites in Tel Aviv at the direction of a Telegram contact in exchange for cryptocurrency and was also asked to target Foreign Minister Gideon Saar’s home, but said he could not during school

item.title: Nuriel Dubin, 27, identified as woman killed in Hezbollah rocket strike in Upper Galilee
item.description: Dubin, a former Golan resident who had recently moved to Margaliot and was due to marry in six months, was killed at Mahanaim Junction as Hezbollah fired about 30 rockets toward the Upper Galilee, wounding one other person

item.title: After the strike: how Israel rebuilds lives in real time
item.description: As missile strikes leave thousands of Israelis without homes, belongings or stable housing, JDC expands into emergency relief, working with local authorities to deliver immediate aid, emotional support and a path to recovery, ensuring no one is left behind

item.title: החשש בישראל מפיגוע איראני בחו"ל בפסח: "זקני הדור לא זוכרים מאמץ כזה"
item.description: אחרי פרסום ההתרעה על פיגועי טרור נגד יעדים ישראליים ויהודיים ברחבי העולם במהלך החג, אמר בכיר במל"ל: "יש מוטיבציית שיא איראנית להישגים באופן מיידי". ההנחיה לפני אירועי ליל הסדר: "להימנע מהגעה למקומות לא מאובטחים"
